gloss: ink pad (for rubber stamps); stamp pad

definitions.gloss: ink pad (for rubber stamps); stamp pad
definitions.explanation: A flat, ink-soaked pad used with rubber stamps to apply ink before stamping. Usually a rectangular plastic case with a fabric or felt pad inside, sold in colors such as black, red, and blue. Distinct from {朱肉|しゅにく}, the specialized vermilion pad used with formal {印鑑|いんかん} seals.

examples.japanese: スタンプ{台|だい}にインクをつける。
examples.english: I put ink on the stamp pad.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}いスタンプ{台|だい}を{貸|か}してください。
examples.english: Please lend me the red stamp pad.

examples.japanese: スタンプ{台|だい}が{乾|かわ}いてきたので、{新|あたら}しいインクを{足|た}した。
examples.english: The stamp pad was getting dry, so I added some new ink.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}でスタンプ{台|だい}をひっくり{返|かえ}して、ノートがインクだらけになった。
examples.english: My child knocked over the stamp pad on the desk, and the notebook got covered in ink.

notes:
Composed of the loanword スタンプ (stamp, rubber stamp) and {台|だい} (stand, base, platform). The {台|だい} here names the pad-holder, not a separate stand.

USAGE:
Paired with rubber stamps (スタンプ) used for office date-stamping, craft projects, スタンプラリー (stamp-collecting events), and school activities. Not typically used with the formal {印鑑|いんかん} seals that require {朱肉|しゅにく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スタンプ{台|だい}にインクをつける: to ink the pad (before stamping)
- スタンプ{台|だい}が{乾|かわ}く: the stamp pad dries out
- {補充|ほじゅう}インク{付|つ}きスタンプ{台|だい}: stamp pad with refill ink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朱肉|しゅにく}: vermilion ink pad — specifically for formal seals ({印鑑|いんかん}); uses a different, oil-based ink and never called スタンプ{台|だい}
- {印|いん}パッド: ink pad — a less common katakana equivalent of スタンプ{台|だい}
- スタンプ: rubber stamp — the stamp itself, applied to the pad before pressing onto paper
